q: The rotation number of an orientation-preserving homeomorphism f of the circle S¹ = ℝ/ℤ is defined via a lift F: ℝ → ℝ as:
exp: Rotation number ρ(f) = lim Fⁿ(0)/n (mod 1), independent of initial point and of the lift (up to integer). f is conjugate to the rotation R_ρ iff ρ is irrational; if ρ is rational p/q, f has a periodic orbit of period q (Poincaré classification).
